mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS seller_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar, u.credit_score AS seller_credit, c.name AS category_name, (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS first_image FROM product p JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (title, description, price, user_id, category_id, `condition`, `status`, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{condition}, #{status}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET favorite_count = IF(favorite_count > 0, favorite_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
